sources.title: ITU Global Connectivity Report 2025
sources.scope: Global; meaningful connectivity dimensions and usage
sources.limitation: Aggregates mask local barriers; report is not a causal experiment

sources.title: Dimensions and barriers for digital (in)equity and digital divide: a systematic integrative review
sources.limitation: Dominated by European and North American studies; not globally representative

sources.title: ITU DataHub
sources.limitation: Monitoring platform, not an intervention or proof of improved access

sources.title: State of Global Water Resources 2025
sources.limitation: Models and observations vary by region; gaps in affected areas

sources.title: HydroSOS — Hydrological Status and Outlook System
sources.limitation: Documentation does not verify local operational coverage or forecast skill

sources.title: Accelerating Clean Cooking and Electricity Services Scenario (ACCESS)
sources.scope: Global access estimates and scenario modelling
sources.limitation: Scenario projections are not proof of implemented electricity services

sources.title: Tracking Universal Health Coverage: 2025 Global Monitoring Report
sources.scope: Global health service coverage and financial hardship time series
sources.limitation: Revised indicators; different observation years; not an impact evaluation

sources.title: Monitoring Universal Health Coverage
sources.limitation: Monitoring capacity, not direct service delivery

sources.title: The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2025
sources.scope: Global food security, food price inflation and healthy-diet affordability
sources.limitation: Global analyses do not establish individual household mechanisms

sources.title: World Cities Report 2026: The Global Housing Crisis
sources.scope: Global housing adequacy, affordability, informality and displacement
sources.limitation: Heterogeneous definitions and estimates; not locality-specific

sources.title: OECD Affordable Housing Database
sources.scope: OECD, EU and key partner housing indicators
sources.limitation: Not globally representative; indicators have comparability caveats

sources.title: Progress on household drinking-water, sanitation and hygiene 2000–2024
sources.scope: Household WASH trends and inequality estimates
sources.limitation: Modelled/interpolated series; incomplete country coverage for some indicators

sources.title: JMP WASH Data
sources.limitation: Data portal is not a water supply intervention

sources.title: Electricity Grids and Secure Energy Transitions
sources.scope: Global grid stocktake and bottleneck risks
sources.limitation: Scenario and cross-market synthesis; not a local outage diagnosis

sources.title: Grid-enhancing technologies for clean energy systems
sources.scope: Technical review of transmission grid-enhancing methods
sources.limitation: Review discusses possibilities and adoption constraints; no universal deployment efficacy

sources.title: Climate-Resilient Agri-Food Systems: A Review of Approaches and Outcomes
sources.limitation: Systemic links and equity effects often incompletely evaluated

sources.title: Monitoring education in the SDGs, GEM 2026
sources.scope: Global education monitoring and learning proficiency
sources.limitation: Learning estimates have limited recency and population coverage

sources.title: Country Learning Poverty Briefs
sources.limitation: Schooling and proficiency are combined; estimates depend on assessments

sources.title: Global Education Policy Dashboard
sources.scope: Measurement of education-system drivers of learning
sources.limitation: Tool documentation does not establish improved student outcomes

sources.title: Privacy-preserving in foundation models: a systematic review of techniques, threats, and trade-offs
sources.limitation: Survey of literature, not independent demonstration of a specific deployment leak

sources.title: Taiwan 2024 free-roaming dog population survey announcement
sources.limitation: Periodic national estimate; reported 2022–2024 difference not statistically significant

sources.title: Population Estimation Methods for Free-Ranging Dogs: A Systematic Review
sources.limitation: Methods have detection and identity assumptions; no local estimator validated here

sources.title: Talea user guide
sources.limitation: Guide states sightings cannot attach animal photos; no individual estimator efficacy demonstrated
